computer_lab: The Central Computer Lab is open from 9 AM to 6 PM on weekdays and from 9 AM to 1 PM on Saturdays. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays. Students must carry their ID card to enter the lab. The lab has 80 systems running Ubuntu 22.04 with Python 3.10 and VS Code installed. Food and drinks are not allowed inside the lab.
wifi: The campus Wi-Fi network is called CampusNet. Students can log in using their university email ID and password. To reset a forgotten Wi-Fi password, visit the IT Help Desk in Block A, Room 12, or email itsupport@campus.edu. A password reset takes up to 24 hours. Each student can connect a maximum of 3 devices at the same time. The Wi-Fi speed is limited to 20 Mbps per student.
printing: Printing is available at the library counter and the Central Computer Lab. Each student gets a free quota of 50 pages per semester. Extra pages cost 2 rupees per page. Colour printing costs 10 rupees per page. Print jobs must be sent from the university portal and collected within 2 days. Payment can be made through UPI or the student wallet.
moodle: Moodle is the learning management system used for assignments and course material. Students log in at moodle.campus.edu using their roll number as the username. The default password is the date of birth in DDMMYYYY format and must be changed on first login. Assignments can be uploaded in PDF or ZIP format only. The maximum file size for an upload is 20 MB. Moodle is also used to view attendance and internal marks.
project_submission: Final year and semester projects must be submitted on Moodle before the deadline. Late submissions are not accepted without prior written permission from the faculty coordinator. Every project report must be in PDF format and must not exceed 60 pages. The plagiarism limit for project reports is 15 percent. Code must be uploaded to a public GitHub repository and the link must be included in the report. A PPT of at most 15 slides is required for the final presentation.
library: The Central Library is open from 8 AM to 8 PM on weekdays. A student can borrow a maximum of 4 books at a time. Books are issued for 14 days and can be renewed once. The late fine is 5 rupees per day for each book. Students must show their ID card to borrow books. The digital library gives access to IEEE and Springer journals through the campus network.
gpu_lab: The Deep Learning Lab is located in Block C, Room 301. It has 10 GPU workstations with NVIDIA RTX 3060 cards. Students must book a slot at least 1 day in advance on the lab portal. Each slot lasts 2 hours and a student can book a maximum of 3 slots per week. Only students with a faculty approval letter can use the lab for project work. The lab is open from 10 AM to 5 PM on weekdays.
student_email: Every student gets a university email ID in the format rollnumber@campus.edu. The email account has 15 GB of storage. The initial password is sent to the registered mobile number. Students must check their university email daily because all notices are sent there. Email accounts remain active for 6 months after graduation. The email can be opened at mail.campus.edu.
id_card: The student ID card is issued during admission and is mandatory on campus. If the ID card is lost, the student must file a request at the Administrative Office, Block B. A duplicate ID card costs 200 rupees. The duplicate card is issued within 5 working days. The ID card is also used for library access and bus travel. A new photo is required for the duplicate card.
attendance: A minimum of 75 percent attendance is compulsory to appear in the end semester exams. Students with attendance between 65 and 75 percent can apply for condonation with a medical certificate. The condonation fee is 500 rupees per subject. Attendance below 65 percent leads to detention in that subject. Attendance is updated on Moodle every week. Attendance for lab sessions is marked separately.
exams_grading: The CGPA is calculated on a 10 point scale. A student must score at least 40 percent in each subject to pass. Internal assessment carries 40 marks and the end semester exam carries 60 marks. Students can apply for re-evaluation within 7 days of result declaration. The re-evaluation fee is 1000 rupees per paper. Backlog exams are held in the month of July.
hostel: Hostel admission is done through the hostel office in Block D. The hostel fee is 60000 rupees per year including mess charges. The hostel gate closes at 10 PM for all students. Visitors are allowed only between 4 PM and 6 PM in the visitor lounge. Each room is shared by 2 students. Laundry service is available twice a week.
transport: The university runs buses on 12 routes covering Delhi, Noida and Ghaziabad. The bus fee is 25000 rupees per year. Buses leave the campus at 4 PM and 5 PM. The bus pass is linked to the student ID card. Students can track buses using the university transport app. The transport office is located near Gate 2.
canteen: The main canteen is open from 8 AM to 7 PM. A meal thali costs 60 rupees. Payment is accepted through UPI, cash and the student wallet. The canteen offers a monthly meal plan for 2500 rupees. A separate juice and snacks counter is located in the library building. Complaints about food quality can be sent to canteen@campus.edu.
software_licences: Students get free access to Microsoft Office 365 using their university email. MATLAB is available through the campus licence and can be installed on a maximum of 2 devices. The licence key can be collected from the IT Help Desk. JetBrains tools are free for students through the GitHub Student Developer Pack. Licensed software must not be shared outside the campus. Software installation requests in labs are handled within 3 working days.
it_helpdesk: The IT Help Desk is located in Block A, Room 12. It is open from 9 AM to 5 PM on weekdays. Students can raise a ticket on the portal at helpdesk.campus.edu. Urgent issues can be reported on the helpline number 1800-111-222. Most tickets are resolved within 48 hours. Hardware complaints for lab computers must be reported to the lab assistant.
hardware_lab: The Electronics and IoT Lab is in Block E, Room 105. Students can borrow Arduino boards and Raspberry Pi kits for a maximum of 7 days. A refundable deposit of 1500 rupees is taken for each kit. Damaged components must be replaced by the student. Lab sessions are held from 2 PM to 5 PM on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Soldering is allowed only under supervision of the lab instructor.
placement_cell: The Training and Placement Cell is located in Block F, 2nd floor. Placement drives start in the 7th semester. Students must have a minimum CGPA of 6.0 to sit in placement drives. Resume workshops are conducted every month. Students must register on the placement portal before applying to any company. A student who accepts an offer is not allowed to sit in further drives unless it is a dream offer.
internships: Students can do internships from the 4th semester onwards. An internship must be at least 6 weeks long to earn credits. The No Objection Certificate is issued by the Training and Placement Cell in 3 working days. Internship certificates must be uploaded on Moodle within 15 days of completion. Students can earn a maximum of 4 credits from internships. A stipend is decided by the company and not by the university.
fees_scholarships: Semester fees must be paid on the university portal before the last date. The late payment fine is 100 rupees per day. Fee receipts can be downloaded from the accounts section of the portal. Merit scholarships are given to students with a CGPA above 9.0. Applications for scholarships are accepted in August. The accounts office is in Block B, Room 4.
clubs_events: The university has over 25 student clubs including the Robotics Club, the Music Society and the Photography Club. Club recruitment happens in the first 2 weeks of the odd semester. The annual tech fest is held every March. Hackathons are conducted by the Coding Club every semester. Students get up to 3 activity points for each event they volunteer in. Event permissions must be taken from the Student Affairs Office.
medical: The Health Centre is open 24 hours a day on campus. A doctor is available from 9 AM to 5 PM and a nurse is available at all other times. Ambulance service can be called on the number 1800-222-333. Students must carry their ID card for treatment. Medical certificates for leave are issued by the Health Centre doctor only. Basic medicines are provided free of cost.
sports: The sports complex is open from 6 AM to 8 PM. It has a cricket ground, a basketball court and a swimming pool. Students must book the badminton court one day in advance at the sports office. The swimming pool is closed on Mondays. Gym membership costs 1000 rupees per semester. Students must wear sports shoes inside the indoor courts.
acceptable_use: Students must not share their login passwords with anyone. Passwords must be at least 8 characters long and must be changed every 90 days. Downloading pirated software or movies on the campus network is strictly prohibited. Violation of the IT policy can lead to a fine of 2000 rupees or suspension of network access. Suspicious emails must be reported to security@campus.edu. Online gaming is blocked on the campus network during class hours.
seminar_hall: The main seminar hall in Block G has a seating capacity of 300 people. It is equipped with a projector, a sound system and air conditioning. Bookings must be made at least 5 days in advance through the Student Affairs Office. The hall can be booked for a maximum of 4 hours at a time. A refundable security deposit of 5000 rupees is required. Photography is allowed only with prior permission.
certificates: Bonafide certificates can be requested from the Academic Office in Block B. A bonafide certificate is issued within 2 working days and costs 50 rupees. Official transcripts take 10 working days and cost 500 rupees. The degree certificate is issued at the convocation ceremony. A lost certificate can be replaced after submitting an FIR copy. All requests are submitted through the certificate section of the university portal.
remote_access: The university VPN lets students access the digital library and lab servers from home. VPN access can be requested at the IT Help Desk. Students must install the OpenVPN client on their laptops. VPN accounts are activated within 1 working day. A VPN session is disconnected automatically after 4 hours of inactivity. The VPN is available to students of the 3rd semester and above.
faculty_support: Faculty office hours are held from 3 PM to 4 PM on weekdays. Students must take an appointment through the mentor portal. Each student is assigned a faculty mentor in the first semester. Mentor meetings are held once every month. Doubt-clearing sessions are conducted on Saturdays from 10 AM to 12 PM. Complaints about teaching can be sent to the Head of Department.
security_lost_found: The campus security office is at Gate 1 and is open 24 hours. Lost items can be reported at the security office. Found items are kept for 30 days before being donated. Two-wheelers must be parked in the parking area near Gate 3. A parking sticker costs 300 rupees per year. Visitors must register at the gate and carry a visitor pass.
coding_platform: The university provides a coding practice platform at code.campus.edu. Students log in with their university email ID. A weekly coding contest is held every Sunday at 8 PM. The top 3 students each month receive a certificate. Contest scores are shared with the Training and Placement Cell. Each contest has 4 problems and lasts 2 hours.
